atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4. Defines the project's design tokens as CSS custom properties. Tokens declared here (--font-*, --color-*, --spacing-*, --breakpoint-*, ...) also generate the matching utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4. Registers an extra path for Tailwind to scan for class names, for files its automatic detection would otherwise miss.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4. Defines a custom utility class that works with variants such as hover: and md:.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4. Applies a Tailwind variant to styles within a rule.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4. Defines a new variant that can then be used as a utility prefix.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS. Inlines existing utility classes into a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4. Imports a stylesheet for its theme and utility definitions only, without duplicating its output. Used in component-scoped styles.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4. Loads a JavaScript Tailwind plugin.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4. Loads a legacy JavaScript tailwind.config.js file.
